id./param/scenario/cs/b_170_cs_050.pack|cs_:
"Huff, puff... I never knew dancing
  took this much stamina...

"Y-you, Norberto!
  You said you'd be gone a while
  seeing your friends again!

"Papa's health improved, and he said he
  wanted to work off the flab, so I taught
  him our dance.

"And Papa took to dancing! He improved
  in no time. Sister's papa, indeed~!

"Q-quiet! Dance, my foot!
  You hogged the room dancing...
  How long are you staying!?

"Oh, Papa, you're so stubborn!
  You said you'd show Sister your dance
  when she got back and surprise her!

"And just now, you said dancing helped
  you understand Sister's feelings a bit,
  all cool and collected!

"Quiet, quiet! I'm a knight!
  I can't be doing frivolous things
  like dancing...

"Thank you, Papa...
  I can't wait to see your dance!
"...A knight never goes back on his word, right?

"...Fine, fine, you win!
  I'll show you a dance so sharp
  your eyes pop out!

"Then it's settled. Starting today,
  the training ground is a dance hall!
  Let's go, you lot!
